result.description: Fictional consumer notebook designed for botanists, hikers, and journalers who need a weather-resistant paper archive rather than digital storage. Features 192 ivory pages, stitched binding, a wraparound elastic band, and a textured outer cover with embossed topographic lines. Includes sewn-in ribbon marker and a back pocket for loose sketches and field tags.
